knowledge_boundary: Mara knows the bridge is failing but not who sabotaged it
Mara has never seen the rival's second technique

purpose: Force Mara to choose between protecting her rank and protecting a rival.

scene_shape.opening_state: Mara expects a controlled qualifying duel and distrusts her rival.
scene_shape.pov_goal: Win without revealing the weakness in her left hand.
scene_shape.opposition: The bridge begins collapsing while the duel continues.
scene_shape.turn: Her rival slips beyond the safety line and cannot recover alone.
scene_shape.choice: Mara abandons the winning position to pull the rival back.
scene_shape.outcome: She loses the official point but exposes the sabotage pattern.
scene_shape.closing_state: Her rank is threatened; the rivalry has become an uneasy debt.

must_include: The left-hand weakness affects one decision
The rival notices the rescue was costly
plants: A clean diagonal fracture suggests deliberate weakening

allowed: Unimportant arena sounds and physical details
Tactical movement consistent with supplied abilities
forbidden: Changes to rank or scoring rules
